description:
Presenting this spacious detached family home in a sought-after north Carlisle location, offering a living dining room and kitchen breakfast room. The property features two ground floor double bedrooms, along with three first-floor double bedrooms and both ground floor and first-floor shower rooms.

With generous gardens to the front and rear, as well as ample off-street parking and a garage, this residence provides convenience and outdoor space. Located in a highly desirable area, close to Rickerby Park, Stanwix village amenities, and excellent transport links, this home is sure to attract strong interest.

While in need of some updating, this property has the potential to be transformed into a stunning family home. Enjoy fantastic views over Rickerby Park to the rear. Early viewing is recommended to secure this fantastic opportunity.

Contact us today to arrange a viewing.

Directions From the centre of Carlisle, head north over Eden Bridges turning right at the traffic lights onto Brampton Road. Follow this past the entrance to Rickerby Park and take the next right onto Longlands Road.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • The land to the rear, cannot be fenced or built on.
